Messages.Author: Orpheus
Messages.Body:
So, after our last game, the following Qs came up :

- Fame is unique ; if you put a second one in game, who contests them ? If
you put both on the same Methuselah, does he contest them with himself ?

- Anesthetic touch says "Only usable at close range. [aus]: Strike: dodge.
[obe]: Strike: make a hand strike. Combat ends immediately after the
resolution of this strike. [OBE]: As [obe] above, with First Strike."
So it's a hand strike. Does it means you can play it even under Immortal
grapple ?!?

- Lightning Reflexes costs one blood, and in sup you can "spend X blood for
X additionals" ; do you still have to play 1 blood first, then X blood, or
is it one or the other ? In other words, you have CEL and want 2
additionals, do you spend 2 or 3 blood ??

- I know it has been debated B4, but could someone please remind me : when
you Spirit Marionette someone and you have Heidelberg Castle in game, can
you tap / use it right after the Spirited minion has acted and right B4 you
give him back, or does it have to B B4 the said action ?

Thanks and Happy Huntings,

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <a6h0fq$rp7$1...@wanadoo.fr>, Orpheus <orph...@wanadoo.fr>
writes:

>So, after our last game, the following Qs came up :
>
>- Fame is unique ; if you put a second one in game, who contests them ?

The controllers of the cards.

Master cards are controlled by the person who played them, regardless of
where they are, unless specified otherwise.

> If
>you put both on the same Methuselah, does he contest them with himself ?

No. The player controls Fame. If you die, the Fames you play go with
you (so your predator doesn't get to use them on your prey, for
instance).

>- Anesthetic touch says "Only usable at close range. [aus]: Strike: dodge.
>[obe]: Strike: make a hand strike. Combat ends immediately after the
>resolution of this strike. [OBE]: As [obe] above, with First Strike."
>So it's a hand strike.

Yes. (Card text.)

>Does it means you can play it even under Immortal
>grapple ?!?

Yes. (Card text.)

(And one might note that that's pretty much the point of the card...)

>- Lightning Reflexes costs one blood, and in sup you can "spend X blood for
>X additionals"

The quotation marks suggest this is a quote. The term is "burn".

> ; do you still have to play 1 blood first,

(Pay) Yes.

> then X blood, or
>is it one or the other ? In other words, you have CEL and want 2
>additionals, do you spend 2 or 3 blood ??

If you want 2 additional strikes, at superior, you spend 1 blood.

You then burn 2 blood.

>- I know it has been debated B4, but could someone please remind me : when
>you Spirit Marionette someone and you have Heidelberg Castle in game, can
>you tap / use it right after the Spirited minion has acted and right B4 you
>give him back, or does it have to B B4 the said action ?

Before is fine. Even with mandatory actions, there is still a phase
during which you can play/use cards usable between actions.

With Spirit Marionette, you keep them until "the end of the next
action". Heidelberg can only be used outside of actions - by which time
I would have said that Spirit Marionette has already handed the vampire
back to its original controller.

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>Ok, so then if I put a second one in the game, I will lose 2 at my next
>untap, right ? And then I can conceed one of them, therefore leaving another
>one in play, still right ?

Actually, you can't put a second one in the game if you already control one
(can't self-contest).

If you manage to gain control of a second one (somehow), then yes, during you
untap phase, you should pay 1 to keep one of them and then yield the other one.
Then the one that you kept will come into play during your next turn.

Halcyan 2

Messages.Body:
In message <a6hr76$92h$1...@wanadoo.fr>, Orpheus <orph...@wanadoo.fr>
writes:
<Anesthetic Touch>

>I tried to look in the Googles archive but didn't quite get the answer to :
>can it be used at long range (if you don't hit the opposing minion, does
>combat end with first strike anyway) ?

[LSJ 20011210]

"Note also the the "combat ends after this strike is resolved" only
applies at close range, since it doesn't say otherwise (and, as before,
it isn't covered by the S:CE rules, so doesn't get the "effective at
long range" benefit of those rules)."
3C14C164...@white-wolf.com

> And it looks like it works even if
>dodged, so it's kind of weird...

It does. Dodge only protects the dodger from effects of a strike.

For instance, a random card that said "Strike: gain 1 blood" would not
be affected by dodge.

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <a6hq0q$8f2$1...@wanadoo.fr>, Orpheus <orph...@wanadoo.fr>
writes:
<Self contestation of Fame>

>Ok, so then if I put a second one in the game, I will lose 2 at my next
>untap, right ?

No.

You cannot put a second one in the game voluntarily.

Self-contestation was removed from the game. You cannot voluntarily do
it. If you are involuntarily doing it, you burn the incoming copy of
the card.

(Note: you can bring in a second copy of Jimmy Dunn, since this is *not*
contesting it.)

[4.1] Be careful about putting duplicates of the same unique cards in
your deck. You can't control more than one of the same unique card at a
time, and you cannot contest cards with yourself. On the other hand, you
may wish to have a second copy handy in case the first is burned.

>And then I can conceed one of them, therefore leaving another
>one in play, still right ?

No.
